description: Correlate source locations, disassembly, registers, and pointer-like locals for the raw fault frame and the first likely project-controlled frame. Use this for low-level root-cause evidence when a crash is already stopped and instruction/operand provenance matters; prefer debug_diagnose_stop for a broader ranked diagnosis. This is read-only, does not resume the target, and returns frame-selection reasoning, both correlations, operand bindings, and any best-effort collection errors.

analysis.description: Hints used to distinguish project code from runtime, system, or third-party frames.

callerDepth.description: How many project-controlled caller frames beyond the selected frame to inspect for provenance and root cause.

projectModules.description: Optional executable or library names treated as project-controlled modules during frame selection.

projectRoots.description: Optional local source-root paths used to recognize project-controlled stack frames.

disassembleAfter.description: Instructions after the selected instruction included in each disassembly window.

disassembleBefore.description: Instructions before the selected instruction included in each disassembly window.

sessionId.description: Optional DAP session ID. Omit to use the backward-compatible default session.

stackLevels.description: Maximum stack frames considered while selecting the project-controlled frame.

threadId.description: Stopped DAP thread to inspect; omit to use the session-selected stopped thread.

name: debug_source_disassembly
title: Correlate Source and Disassembly
